SAP_BW_MIGRATION.V_DS_SALES_HEADER_TO_AD.@EndUserText.label: View for TR_DS_TO_STG (DS_SALES_HEADER -> ADSO_SALES_STG)
SAP_BW_MIGRATION.V_DS_SALES_HEADER_TO_AD.query:
SELECT
    "VBELN" AS "VBELN",
    "ERDAT" AS "ERDAT",
    "KUNNR" AS "KUNNR",
    "NETWR" AS "NETWR",
    "WAERK" AS "WAERK"
FROM "SAP_BW_MIGRATION"."DS_SALES_HEADER"

SAP_BW_MIGRATION.V_ADSO_SALES_STG_TO_ADS.@EndUserText.label: View for TR_STG_TO_CUBE (ADSO_SALES_STG -> ADSO_SALES_CUBE)
SAP_BW_MIGRATION.V_ADSO_SALES_STG_TO_ADS.query:
SELECT
    "KUNNR" AS "0CUSTOMER",
    "ERDAT" AS "0CALDAY",
    CASE WHEN NETWR > 0 THEN NETWR ELSE 0 END AS "0AMOUNT"
FROM "SAP_BW_MIGRATION"."ADSO_SALES_STG"
WHERE NOT ((KUNNR IS NULL OR KUNNR = '') OR KUNNR = '0000000000')
